<!-- pr-reviewer: 8a25605402a90e1d3587d40135aa08ecf7ecbbed -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The three new tests meet issue #1940. Each test checks the specified refusal message and a related input that must succeed. The tests use the app commands and operation API. The decision record explains the fixtures and the alternatives.

Local results in `.claude/worktrees/review-2085`:
- Trial merge with upstream/main `31f8d03d744e77ce707282d816e11efe0922f239`: clean. That main commit is already an ancestor of the PR head.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test contour_stock_run --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: selected the complete `app:contour_stock_run` suite.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed; 8 tests passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `git diff --check upstream/main`: passed.

Requested changes: none.

Notes: This PR changes only tests and the decision record. It does not change production G-code, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation, or geometry. It does not change golden files or UI files. Mutation checks were not repeated in this review. The mutation results in the PR body are the author's evidence. Cargo used the worktree's own target directory with the host compiler wrapper disabled. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
